images.inspection: Opened entire original PNG with detail=original at native dimensions; inspected anatomy, support, coat, props and full composition.
findings: Neet has continuous chest, abdomen and pelvis in the narrow chair gap. Each forepaw braces on its own armrest; two fine hindlegs meet carpet separately. Head, neck and body connect without the old disconnected-rest problem; short nub remains close to rump.

Buddy has a continuous long reclining torso through neck and supported head. Near foreleg extends onto blanket, far forepaw lies under cheek; folded visible hindleg belongs to same pelvis and far hindleg is occluded. Cushion and blanket support body mass; tapering tail rests along left edge.

Neet body finish is close smooth coat. Buddy torso is a restrained dark short surface with no repeated engraved curls or shag volume. Furnishings are concentrated on ear flaps, brows, muzzle/chin and distal paws; regional tan flank and leg fields are retained. Pale muzzle remains irregular with projecting nose rather than a round fluffy ball.

Automated chair controls, extended footrest, aircraft windows and contrast between Buddy comfort and Neet gap predicament match the anchored moment before Heather frees Neet. No additional human contradicts historical household. Both dogs own separate spaces and poses; comedy reads without lettering.

images.inspection: Opened entire original PNG with detail=original at native dimensions; inspected anatomy, support, coat, props and full composition.
findings: Neet tall sit has full folded thighs, two grounded fine forelegs, compact hindfeet and continuous neck. Modest head, projecting muzzle, broad ear cups, cream chin/chest and tiny visible rear nub stay within N05/N19 identity. No extra limbs or unowned paws.
Coat is rendered as smooth broad washes and low-contrast surface grain rather than long fur or engraved curl strokes. Silhouette stays close and restrained.

Businessman has two coherent hands: raised espresso-cup hand exposes cufflink while opposite wrist is covered by its cuff. Small cup and open laptop agree with the text. Neet upward attention targets the raised-hand/cuff area; adjacent leather chairs and aircraft window preserve lounge context.

New shiny-object discovery differs usefully from food evidence and chair predicament. Image is located after cup rise and before Heather removes Neet, so no carried object or pose is ahead of its narrative state.
